prop.capitalAtRiskDefinition: Cumulative non-refundable challenge and reset fees paid by the trader. Contractual rule risk and lost future opportunity are reported separately, not assigned a fabricated dollar capital base.
prop.capitalCommittedDefinition: Cumulative trader-paid challenge and reset fees; nominal account capacity is not treated as trader-owned capital.

selfFundedA.capitalAtRiskDefinition: The self-funded account equity committed to the strategy.
selfFundedA.exposure: Fixed dollar exposure equal to the matched prop exposure; no compounding of position size.
selfFundedA.fees: No prop challenge/reset fees and no payout split. Strategy transaction costs and observed execution calibration remain embedded in the return path.
selfFundedA.negativeEquityTreatment: No artificial stopout; losses continue on the fixed exposure and may exceed starting capital in a simulated extreme path.
selfFundedA.returnPath: The same sampled, execution-calibrated Optimized DM daily return path used by the prop account.
selfFundedA.startingAndCommittedCapital: Exactly the effective exposure: nominalAccount multiplied by scale ($20,000 or $25,000).

selfFundedB.reason: No legitimate, previously preregistered personal stop/restart rule exists. A restart rule will not be invented after seeing outcomes.

classification.reason: Self-funding avoids prop fees, payout splits, and stopouts when enough own capital is available; prop accounts provide matched exposure with much less trader cash committed. The selected one-year historical sample cannot establish which advantage will dominate prospectively.

historicalClassification: selected development sample plus synthetic moving-block Monte Carlo
